name: YouTube Sub List Viewer + TV Scheduler

mentions.name: YouTube Sub List Viewer + TV Scheduler
mentions.description: This app is a YouTube subscription list viewer and TV scheduler that lets users build and share custom YouTube TV stations. Its primary table view supports double column sorting, and middle-clicking the title column queues a playlist based on the current sort, generating a playlist of a set duration modified by playback speed with options like skipping watched videos, making it easy to stay up to date with your own subs. It can boot into a TV mode, and setup uses a Google Sheet with Apps Script so the user's own YouTube API quota is accessed; syncing between devices costs a nominal fee.
mentions.problem: Staying up to date with one's own YouTube subscriptions.
mentions.audience: People who want to stay up to date with their own YouTube subscriptions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Youtube sub list viewer + Youtube TV scheduler

Setup a little finicky, have to do via google sheet / appscript to access use your youtube API quota.

Build and share custom youtube TV stations.

I mainly use the primary table view, you can double sort columns, middle click title column to queue a playlist based on how table is sorted, it'll generate playlist for X minutes, modified by playback speed, skipwatched filled etc, very useful for staying up to date with your own subs.
